description: The tactica. Case File for one fixture: the forecast, the score grid (exact-score chances), what drove the forecast, an evidence summary and the predicted line-ups. The forecast revision history and bulk evidence rows are left out unless include asks for them. Use this when you need the reasoning or score-level detail. Use get_match_forecast instead for the headline chances only (cheaper), or get_betting_picks for recommended bets. Read-only; the latest Case File for the fixture. Paid: 1.00 USDC per call, via x402 on Base. Charged only after the content is ready; nothing is charged when it is unavailable.

fixtureId.description: Required. The tactica. fixture id, copied from the fixtureId field of list_fixtures. Letters, digits and . _ ~ -, up to 128 characters. Example: ce_0cefbf3ead8d4992af69b4f07f6c4113

include.description: Optional. history and/or evidence, comma separated: adds the forecast revision history and/or the bulk evidence rows, which are left out by default to keep the Case File small. No extra charge. Example: history

name: get_case_file
title: Get a match Case File
